title: LAN Wizard Profile Fix — Route Internal Network to Correct Discovery Profile
goal: Fix the wizard so that selecting 'Internal LAN' as assessment type routes to the passive-network-discovery profile (nmap host + service scan) instead of passive-web-baseline (web-only), so internal scans actually find hosts and services instead of returning zero findings.
scope: Fix the wizard assessment type to run profile mapping: (1) When the operator selects 'Internal LAN' tile (or the wizard detects a private IP CIDR like 10.x, 192.168.x, 172.16-31.x), the default profile must be 'passive-network-discovery' (nmap -sn + service fingerprint), not 'passive-web-baseline'. (2) Add a second follow-up profile suggestion after discovery: when nmap completes and hosts are found, the wizard or Mission Control should prompt 'X hosts discovered — run vulnerability scan on discovered services? [Yes →]'. (3) Fix the profile display in the wizard preview: show which tools will actually run for the selected profile. (4) Add validation: if the target is a private CIDR and the selected profile is web-only, show a warning: 'This looks like an internal network. The web-only profile may not find LAN vulnerabilities. Switch to Internal Network profile?' with a one-click fix. (5) Ensure the 'Internal LAN' assessment chain (from backlog-76 when built) maps correctly to the nmap-first → vulnerability scan → credential attack chain.
generation_reason: The user ran a LAN scan on 10.0.20.0/24 and found 0 findings. Inspection shows the run used passive-web-baseline which only scans HTTP/HTTPS — completely wrong for a LAN assessment. The wizard is not routing private CIDRs to the network discovery profile. This is a correctness bug that makes LAN assessments appear to produce nothing even when there are real vulnerabilities.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Profile routing fix and validation warning only. No new runners. No new profiles beyond existing ones. The operator can still override to any profile via Advanced Settings.

Wizard shows a warning when private CIDR is paired with web-only profile.
After nmap discovery, Mission Control suggests following up with vulnerability scan.
Wizard preview shows actual tools that will run for the selected profile.
Tests cover private CIDR detection, profile routing, and warning display.

acceptance_criteria: Warning shown for web profile + LAN target.
